name: GapFill Nearest-Region U-Net
input_description: Training contract: 2-channel binary masks [Line-only boundary mask, target gap mask]. The Web compatibility runtime historically supplies Line OR effective Guides in channel 0.

channels.0: Training: canonical Line Art mask only; Guides are excluded because training did not supply them. Web compatibility runtime: alpha(Line) OR alpha(effective Guides), with the target Guide gap excluded from effective Guides.

runtime_policy: The model was trained with Line-only channel 0. The Web product intentionally preserves its pre-addon Line-or-effective-Guides compatibility behavior; this does not imply Guide-composed training data.
